state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country at the company's request today? (answer in EUR)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for IT hardware bought by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the bike-leasing allowance for a regular employee leasing an e-bike with the insurance package today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q4: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q5: What is the taxi allowance for a daytime business taxi ride with trade-fair luggage today? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q6: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-05-15? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: taxi allowance a daytime business taxi ride with trade-fair luggage
state.step_intent: Find the taxi allowance that applies to: What is the taxi allowance for a daytime business taxi ride with trade-fair luggage today?

passages.source: HB-71 §3 | Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-50
passages.text: For rides with luggage for a trade fair, 21 EUR per ride is added to the standard taxi allowance. The travel office reviews the taxi allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. The travel office publishes worked examples of the taxi allowance on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-71 §2 | Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing — Standard taxi allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-50
passages.text: A single taxi or ride-hailing trip on business is reimbursed up to 45 EUR. The travel office publishes worked examples of the taxi allowance on the intranet. Each claim for the taxi allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-50 §2 | Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing — Standard taxi allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-05-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-71
passages.text: A single taxi or ride-hailing trip on business was reimbursed up to 31 EUR. Questions about the taxi allowance go to the travel office, who keeps the record of decisions. The travel office reviews the taxi allowance once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-71 §1 | Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing — Scope | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-50
passages.text: This policy sets the taxi allowance for all employees. The travel office publishes worked examples of the taxi allowance on the intranet. Questions about the taxi allowance go to the travel office, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-50 §1 | Travel policy: taxis and ride-hailing — Scope | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-05-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-71
passages.text: This version set the taxi allowance for all employees. Each claim for the taxi allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. Managers confirm claims for the taxi allowance before payment in the next payroll run.
